messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — GPU queue growth in us-west-2. Autoscaler hitting scale limits and provider 429s. Queue length > 3x baseline, eviction rate rising. Runbook: <runbook link>
cheryl_oncall: grabbing this one, oncall here. @alex_engine @ryan_sre pls ack. Any immediate customer reports? :eyes:
alex_engine: ack. joining. quick scan: autoscaler logs show 'scaleup rejected: provider_quota_exceeded' and repeated launch failures. snippet: `2026-05-14T02:12:30Z ERROR scaleup_rejected reason=quota limit project=gpu-pools`
ryan_sre: ack. seeing provider 429s + failed instanceCreate calls. Also fallback pools not activating due to poolSelector AZ constraint mismatch. Trying manual override to unblock scheduling.
devops_bot: autoscaler:attempt_scaleup id=as-1780 result=rate_limited at=2026-05-14T02:13:01Z
cheryl_oncall: ok we have two levers: (A) temporary eviction_override to stop churn for affected tenants, (B) manual capacity bump via provider console. Both have tradeoffs. Recommend do (A) now + (B) parallel.
alex_engine: I'm +1 on eviction_override first. Applying temporary patch to avoid OOM-evictions and let queue drain. Running: `kubectl patch configmap autoscaler -n infra --patch '{"data":{"eviction_override":"true"}}'` — will report when applied.
alex_engine: patch applied. autoscaler config now eviction_override=true. Observability: eviction events dropping to 0 within 60s.
ryan_sre: confirmed patch applied. queue length trending down but not yet back to baseline. Provider is still rate-limiting scaleups. Starting manual pool creation: creating 2 on-demand nodes in us-west-2a, us-west-2b.
emma_prod: customer ops update: we have 12 incoming alerts from top customers; two 504s from an embeddings-heavy tenant. No SLA breaches yet but error budget is close. Preparing customer-facing note; please keep me posted on ETA.
cheryl_oncall: starting short bridge for coordination and postmortem planning at 09:30 PT. Keep evict override for 30 minutes unless queue fully recovers. @emma_prod will handle customer comms.
devops_bot: autoscaler: manual_scale id=manual-1780 result=created_nodes=2 type=ondemand
alex_engine: after manual nodes came up, autoscaler attempted normal scaleup again and succeeded to allocate burst nodes, but noticed AZ spread constraint still causing scheduler pressure — ticketed: INF-3145 (autoscaler az-spread constraint + provider quota interplay).
ryan_sre: mitigation summary: eviction_override in place + 2 on-demand nodes added -> queue length 3.2k -> 450 over 22m, pod binding failures 12 -> 1. Will remove eviction_override once steady for 10m.
cheryl_oncall: eviction_override removed at +28m. Observed steady state and routing fallbacks applied for small-embedding requests (<256 tokens) to CPU fallback service. Closing pager. Action items: 1) provider quota pre-warm and alert (owner: alex_engine, INF-3145), 2) autoscaler retry/backoff + clearer metrics for quota vs capacity (owner: ryan_sre, INF-3146), 3) routing fallback test coverage + customer comms runbook (owner: emma_prod), 4) postmortem doc + timeline (owner: cheryl_oncall). Please create tickets and add to the postmortem board. :white_check_mark:
devops_bot: incident-summary generated id=is-1780012345 sev=P1 duration=28m mitigations=[eviction_override, manual_nodes, routing_fallback] tickets=[INF-3145,INF-3146]
emma_prod: I'll send customer note template and update the affected customers list. Thanks team — great coordination.
